HiSparse host-resident sparse-MLA KV offload 核心实现（3/N），当日最大 commit（124 文件，+14373/-1017）。为长上下文稀疏 MLA（DeepSeek V3.2/V4、GLM-5）引入 host-resident KV tier + GPU hot buffer：decode 时 top-K 先查 GPU LRU hot cache，miss 时从 pinned host pool DMA 拷贝到 hot buffer，resident 页面命中直接旁路。核心新增：(1) csrc/libtorch_stable/hisparse_kernels.cu 的 4 个 CUDA kernel（residency 解析、plan gather、compact gather、written-slot 失效），显式 #ifndef USE_ROCM；(2) vllm/v1/hisparse/ 新模块（coordinator/layout/binding/runtime/block_pool/types）；(3) KVCacheSpec/KVCacheGroupSpec 扩展（HiSparseHotSpec/HiSparseResidentSpec/SparseCacheRole/KVCacheGroupRole/host_resident）；(4) SingleTypeKVCacheManager 新增 HiSparseSource/Hot/ResidentManager；(5) KV connector 框架大规模重构：KVConnectorTransferResults、KVConnectorOutput.failed_recving、bind_kv_cache_manager、finish_forward、reset_capture_state、has_pending_block_frees、ActiveKVConnector.pre_forward 增加 **kwargs；(6) MLA 稀疏后端（FlashMLA/FlashInfer/FlashAttn/SM120）统一接入 SparseMLAIndexGroup/HiSparseMLAIndexGroup，MLAAttention 的 KV cache 更新重构为 update_kv_cache/prepare_kv_cache_update 入口；(7) NIXL/Mooncake/Offloading connector 适配。风险极高：公共接口扩展面大但多数带默认实现；KVCacheManager 的 delay_cache_blocks 语义从 `not enable_caching or delay_cache_blocks` 变为仅 `delay_cache_blocks`，BlockPool 新增 unpin_blocks/reuse watcher，这些是全局行为变更；SparseMLACommonImpl 默认创建 index_group 改变 decode 转换路径；HiSparse 配置在 VllmConfig 中明确拒绝非 CUDA 平台。

ascend_impact.functionality: 命中多个必然影响路径：vllm/v1/attention/backend.py、vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py、vllm/distributed/device_communicators/base_device_communicator.py（间接，通过 KVConnectorBase_V1 所在目录）、vllm/v1/core/sched/output.py。具体影响：(1) AttentionImplBase 新增 prepare_for_batch 默认方法，MLAAttentionImpl 新增 hisparse_cache 类属性（默认 None），不破坏编译；但 MLAAttention.forward 的 KV cache 更新重构为 update_kv_cache/prepare_kv_cache_update 统一入口，MultiHeadLatentAttentionWrapper/DeepseekV32Attention 前向新增 record_logical_topk_ready/prepare_for_batch 调用，vllm-ascend 的 MLA/DSA 后端和模型层前向若覆写相关方法需同步新钩子。(2) KVCacheSpec/KVCacheGroupSpec 新增字段与属性（host_resident/role/has_layer_views/uses_slot_mapping/block_table_token_alignment），均为带默认值的向后兼容扩展；但 KVCacheConfig 新增 hisparse_host_num_blocks 且 get_max_concurrency_for_kv_cache_config 将 host 组与 device 组分开计算，Ascend 自定义 KV cache spec 若未设置 host_resident（默认 False）则走原逻辑。(3) KVConnectorBase_V1 新增 bind_kv_cache_manager/finish_forward/reset_capture_state/has_pending_block_frees/get_transfer_results 默认方法，KVConnectorOutput 新增 failed_recving 字段；ActiveKVConnector.pre_forward 签名从 (scheduler_output) 变为 (scheduler_output, **kwargs) 且内部状态机从 _pending_load_start 改为 _pending_load_kwargs，vllm-ascend 若使用 vLLM 的 ActiveKVConnector/KVConnector 框架（如 kv_offload 路径）需要适配 kwargs 传递和 finish_forward 时机。(4) vllm/v1/core/block_pool.py 与 kv_cache_manager.py 行为变更：KVCacheBlock 新增 pool 字段、BlockPool.unpin_blocks/reuse watcher、KVCacheManager 的 delay_cache_blocks 条件不再包含 enable_caching，所有平台（含 Ascend 调度器）的 prefix caching 与延迟缓存行为需重新验证。HiSparse 本身在 VllmConfig 中强制要求 CUDA 平台，Ascend 不可启用，但上述公共接口变更对 Ascend 有真实影响。
ascend_impact.testing: vllm-ascend 需要回归：稀疏 MLA 后端在非 HiSparse 配置下的 KV cache 更新路径（update_kv_cache/prepare_kv_cache_update）、KV cache manager 的 delay_cache_blocks 语义变化、KV connector 接口兼容性（若使用 vLLM connector 框架）。
suggested_test_areas: vllm_ascend/attention/（Ascend MLA/DSA 后端的 KV cache 更新路径与 prepare_for_batch/record_logical_topk_ready 钩子）

affected_interfaces.impact: Hard break. Function renamed to bind_kv_cache_to_layers, signature changed (runner_kv_caches positional arg removed, kv_cache_groups added). Direct `from vllm.v1.worker.utils import bind_kv_cache` raises ImportError; the monkey-patches become dead code because upstream now calls bind_kv_cache_to_layers. The new function no longer calls current_platform.check_runner_kv_caches_multi_layer(), so the original Ascend workaround target is gone.

affected_interfaces.vllm_ascend_usage: vllm_ascend/worker/v2/attn_utils.py (own get_kv_cache_spec); NPUModelRunner MRV2 initialize_kv_cache calls super()
affected_interfaces.impact: init_kv_cache signature changed (runner_kv_caches removed, kw-only block_tables added); GPUModelRunner.initialize_kv_cache now derives self.kv_caches from the returned dict (device-filtered) instead of the caller's list. get_kv_cache_spec now calls resolve_hisparse_block_size (no-op when hisparse_config is None).

kv_connector.pre_forward now takes scheduler_output + request_state_indices/request_ids/num_tokens kwargs (and attn_metadata in FULL-graph mode); new kv_connector.finish_forward() called after model forward; update_requests now applies scheduler_output.block_table_updates.

Upstream DeepseekV2DecoderLayer now always passes index_group_builder=<...> (even None) when attn_cls is DeepseekV2MLAAttention. The patched __init__ does not accept this kwarg -> TypeError at model load for DeepSeek-V2/V3/Kimi-K2/GLM paths that build upstream DeepseekV2MLAAttention on Ascend.

New fields cache_role (SparseCacheRole.SPARSE) and is_index_group_leader (False) with defaults; merge now asserts group-wide uniformity. Ascend specs all keep defaults so this passes, but must not be mixed with CUDA indexer-style specs. New KVCacheSpec properties (block_table_token_alignment=128, has_layer_views, uses_slot_mapping) are backward-compatible (defaults match prior behavior).

affected_interfaces.vllm_ascend_usage: vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_p2p/* (Mooncake, SFA remote D2H), kv_pool/* (UCM, recompute offload, ascend_store) — subclass KVConnectorBase_V1 and override get_finished/start_load_kv
affected_interfaces.impact: Worker flow now calls get_transfer_results() (base delegates to get_finished, so existing overrides still work), start_load_kv now receives extra kwargs, and new default no-op finish_forward()/reset_capture_state()/bind_kv_cache_manager()/has_pending_block_frees() were added.

Scheduler now calls connector.bind_kv_cache_manager() instead of bind_gpu_block_pool(); BlockPool gains medium param + unpin_blocks/_reuse_watchers; get_manager_for_kv_cache_spec/get_manager_class gained a defaulted role arg (single-arg calls still work). Additive, low risk.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
The HiSparse feature itself is NVIDIA-CUDA-only (VllmConfig raises 'HiSparse currently requires NVIDIA CUDA' on non-CUDA, and its hisparse_kernels.cu / vllm/v1/hisparse/ are never activated on Ascend), but the commit ships large refactors to shared worker/KV-connector/MLA interfaces that vllm-ascend depends on. Required fixes:

1. vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py:4342, vllm_ascend/_310p/worker/v2/model_runner.py:40,738, vllm_ascend/_310p/model_runner_310p.py:717 — change `from vllm.v1.worker.utils import bind_kv_cache` to `bind_kv_cache_to_layers`, drop the `runner_kv_caches` (self.kv_caches) positional argument, and populate the runner's kv-cache list separately (e.g. from kv_caches.values() ordered by layer index); pass `kv_cache_groups=self.kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups`.
2. vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_bind_kv_cache.py and vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_attn_utils.py — retarget/remove the bind_kv_cache monkey-patches. Verify upstream bind_kv_cache_to_layers (which no longer calls current_platform.check_runner_kv_caches_multi_layer()) works for the MRV2 path; keep the patch only if forward_context[layer_name].bind_kv_cache(kv_cache) still misbehaves on NPU.
3. vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_deepseek_v2.py:57 — add `index_group_builder: 'SparseMLAIndexGroupBuilder | None' = None` to _deepseek_v2_mla_attention_init (accept and ignore/forward) so DeepSeek-V2/V3/Kimi-K2/GLM builds don't raise TypeError. Confirm AscendMultiHeadLatentAttention (ops/mla.py) needs no index-group plumbing (its own forward bypasses the new record_logical_topk_ready hook).
4. KV connectors (vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_p2p/*, kv_pool/*) — validate the get_transfer_results/finish_forward/reset_capture_state flow and the new start_load_kv(**kwargs) forwarding; most overrides already accept **kwargs so this is mainly regression testing. Keep get_finished overrides intact (base get_transfer_results delegates to them).
5. vllm_ascend/core/kv_cache_interface.py — no structural change needed, but verify AscendMLAAttentionSpec/AscendSFAIndexerCacheSpec groups stay uniform on cache_role/is_index_group_leader (all default SPARSE/False) so the tightened MLAAttentionSpec.merge assertion holds.
6. MRV2 NPUModelRunner.initialize_kv_cache — after super(), confirm self.kv_caches ordering/device filtering from the new dict-derived list matches ACL graph capture expectations, and that init_kv_cache's kw-only block_tables is provided (super() handles it).
7. No action needed for the new HiSparseConfig/VllmConfig validation (CUDA-gated, inert when unset); optionally add an Ascend guard test that hisparse_config is rejected cleanly.
deep_analysis.risk: Medium. Two hard runtime breaks: (a) the bind_kv_cache -> bind_kv_cache_to_layers rename causes ImportError on the MRV1 and 310P model-runner paths and silently disables the Ascend bind patches; (b) the new index_group_builder kwarg passed into DeepseekV2MLAAttention.__init__ raises TypeError in the patched _deepseek_v2_mla_attention_init for DeepSeek-family models. Secondary risk is behavioral drift in KV-connector bookkeeping (get_transfer_results vs get_finished, finish_forward, pre_forward kwargs, update_requests block_table_updates) which could misreport send/receive completion or block-release timing on Ascend PD/offload connectors if not regression-tested; and the re-derived self.kv_caches list could subtly change ACL-graph capture ordering on the MRV2 path.

commits.comment: DeepSeek V4 NVIDIA CuTeDSL attention kernel 迁移到 JIT warmup 框架（5/N）：将 dequant_gather_k、fused_indexer_q、sparse_attn_compress 系列从 @cache static compile + 模块级函数调用重构为 VllmCuTeDSLJitKernel 子类 + @kernel_launcher 声明式装饰器 + get_warmup_keys/warmup_inputs 显式 warmup，使编译与运行时共享 executor 并支持 PDL warmup。同步将 kernel_launcher 从 jit_warmup_triton_helper.py 上移到 vllm/model_executor/warmup/jit_warmup.py 通用化；VllmTritonJitKernel.launch 签名从 (grid, inputs, /, *, kernel=..., **kwargs) 改为 (launch_spec, inputs)；CuTeDSLLaunchSpec 类型扩展为 2/3/4 元组（支持 output 和 finalizer 闭包）；VllmJitKernel 新增 bind_launch_inputs 类属性。所有 vLLM 内部调用者已同步更新。风险：kernel_launcher 的 import 路径变化对 OOT 平台（如 vllm-ascend）是潜在 ImportError 源；VllmTritonJitKernel.launch 签名是破坏性变更，任何继承该框架并直接调用 launch 的三方代码需要同步；CuTeDSL 部分本身是 NVIDIA 特有路径。

ascend_impact.functionality: 命中可能影响路径 vllm/compilation/ 关联的 warmup 子系统（vllm/model_executor/warmup/）。破坏性变更：(1) vllm/model_executor/warmup/jit_warmup_triton_helper.py 删除 kernel_launcher 定义（迁移到 vllm/model_executor/warmup/jit_warmup.py），vllm-ascend 的 triton 内核（vllm_ascend/ops/triton/）若从旧路径 import kernel_launcher 会 ImportError；(2) VllmTritonJitKernel.launch 签名从 (grid, inputs, /, *, kernel=..., **kwargs) 改为 (launch_spec, inputs)，继承 VllmTritonJitKernel 并覆写/直接调用 launch(grid, inputs, ...) 的代码会编译失败；(3) VllmJitKernel 新增 bind_launch_inputs 类属性（默认 True），kernel_launcher 自动绑定调用参数作为 inputs，三方自定义 launcher 行为可能变化。CuTeDSL kernel 迁移本身（vllm/models/deepseek_v4/nvidia/ops/）是 NVIDIA 路径，Ascend 不使用。

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
本 commit 是 [5/N][warmup][DSv4] 系列的 NVIDIA CuTeDSL 内核迁移：核心 3100 行改动在 vllm/models/deepseek_v4/nvidia/ops/*.py（纯 NVIDIA CuTeDSL，Ascend 不使用，且全部经 `has_cutedsl()`/`current_platform.is_cuda()` 门控，Ascend 运行时仍走 Triton 路径，DeepseekCompressor 的 CuTeDSL 分支以 `current_platform.is_cuda() and head_dim==512` 保护）。Ascend 需要适配的是共享 warmup 基础设施的破坏性变更：
1. 全局检索 vllm-ascend 源码中所有 `from vllm.model_executor.warmup.jit_warmup_triton_helper import kernel_launcher`，改为 `from vllm.model_executor.warmup.jit_warmup import kernel_launcher`（commit 已从旧模块删除该符号，未改会导致 ImportError）。重点检查 `vllm_ascend/ops/triton/` 和 `vllm_ascend/compilation/`。
2. 检查 `VllmTritonJitKernel.launch` 的调用/覆写：旧签名 `launch(grid, inputs, /, *, kernel=None, **kwargs)` 已改为 `launch(launch_spec, inputs)`，其中 `launch_spec` 为 `(grid, launch_kwargs)` 或 `(grid, launch_kwargs, outputs)` 二元/三元组（LaunchSpec）。若有继承 `VllmTritonJitKernel` 自定义 launcher 的代码需同步；`kernel` 现从 `launch_kwargs.pop('kernel')` 取出，`_runtime_launcher`/`_runtime_launcher_arg_count` 语义保留。
3. 注意 `VllmJitKernel` 新增 `bind_launch_inputs=True` 类属性：Triton 内核默认绑定调用实参为 inputs（行为同旧）；CuTeDSL 内核设为 False。三方自定义 launcher 若依赖旧的调用参数绑定行为需核对。
4. 回归验证 DeepSeek V4 / V4.1 在 NPU 上执行：确认 `dequantize_and_gather_k_cache`、`fused_indexer_q_rope_quant` 等 common ops 在 `has_cutedsl()=False` 时进入 Triton/其他分支，`DeepseekV4Indexer.__init__` 中新增的 `_INDEXER_Q_*_KERNEL.register_warmup()` 受 `is_cuda() and has_cutedsl()` 门控不会在 NPU 触发。
5. 关注后续 6/N 系列 commit 同步演进该框架。
deep_analysis.risk: 中等。主要风险：(1) import 路径变更导致 vllm-ascend 启动时 ImportError（若仍从 `jit_warmup_triton_helper` 导入 `kernel_launcher`），这是编译期/加载期硬失败；(2) `VllmTritonJitKernel.launch` 是破坏性签名变更，任何直接调用或覆写该方法的 Ascend 代码会静默/显式失败；(3) `bind_launch_inputs` 与新的 `launch_spec` 语义可能改变自定义 launcher 的输入绑定行为；(4) 尽管运行时门控保证了 CuTeDSL 分支不会在 NPU 启用，但同系列前序 1/N/2/N/4/N 均被标记 ascend_affected，若 vllm-ascend 尚未完全跟进该 JIT warmup 框架（enable_jit_warmup 默认 True），DeepSeek V4 稀疏 MLA/索引器路径存在编译或注册行为回归风险，需在 NPU 上跑 DSV4 warmup + 推理回归。
